'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
